description: Burundi - Potential Mini-Grids Sites With Household And Business Data is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Project sites", published or maintained by Min Jaegal (World Bank Group). The World Bank working with EED Advisory Limited carried out the Burundi MTF energy survey to provide national-level insights into the status of access to electricity. The survey extended to identify 120 high-potential mini-grids sites in the country. Coverage: Burundi. It has 4 files in ZIP. The portal files it under Energy access, Project sites. The portal gives 2022 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
